name: 10-manchester-zone
title: The Manchester Zone
description: Build the CloudStack Manchester zone the reader lab creates by hand in the deployment guide's Section 7.2 wizard, but as gated cmk commands on mgmt-01: an advanced zone with one physical network carrying Management/Guest/Public traffic on the cloudbr0/1/2 labels, the VirtualRouter provider enabled so system VMs can start, the public IP range, pod MAN-Pod-01, cluster MAN-Prod-01, both KVM compute hosts, RBD primary storage rbd-prod (untagged) and rbd-dev (tagged DEV), and NFS secondary storage; then the zone is enabled. Every command is a cmk call a reader can read and re-run; each is idempotent via a cmk-list probe, so a stopped build resumes rather than repeats.
source: Route (a), ratified by the maintainer 2026-07-23: cmk over Nano's SSH transport. Commands DERIVED from ebooks/matrixclaw-framework scenarios/lab-manchester-zone.yaml and the proven adapter sequence in engine/matrixclaw/adapter/live.py (createZone -> createPhysicalNetwork -> addTrafficType x3 -> updatePhysicalNetwork -> VirtualRouter enablement -> createVlanIpRange -> createPod -> addCluster -> addHost x2 -> createStoragePool x2 -> addImageStore -> updateZone Enabled), which built the live Manchester zone on 2026-07-20 (run mc-20260720-224106). cmk verbs mirror the API command names; cmk's asyncblock polls async jobs, so no manual poll is transcribed.
honesty: Steps change the CloudStack management state and are gated. Each carries a cmk-list 'already' probe, so a re-run skips what exists. Two secrets the maintainer places in mgmt-01's root-only /root/.mc-secrets.env (d-mc-010) are needed and sourced without ever entering a record: MC_HOST_ROOTPASS (the KVM hosts' root password, for addHost) and MC_RBD_SECRET (the client.cloudstack cephx key, for the rbd pools). A precondition step fails fast if either is missing. Checks are read-only cmk-list commands with exact-match markers so they cannot pass on their own error text. System VMs and the built-in template come up minutes after the zone is enabled, so cp11/cp13 are left to lab-smoke rather than claimed here.

steps.title: Register cmk API keys for admin
steps.run: uid=$(cmk list users username=admin | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["user"][0]["id"])') && resp=$(cmk register userkeys id="$uid") && ak=$(printf %s "$resp" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["userkeys"]["apikey"])') && sk=$(printf %s "$resp" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["userkeys"]["secretkey"])') && cmk set apikey "$ak" >/dev/null && cmk set secretkey "$sk" >/dev/null && cmk sync >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo API-KEYS-REGISTERED || { echo 'register-api-keys FAILED (cmk auth or registerUserKeys). Diagnose on mgmt-01: cmk list users username=admin ; cmk register userkeys id=<uid>' >&2; exit 1; }

steps.title: Zone-build secrets present and non-empty
steps.run: sudo bash -c '. /root/.mc-secrets.env && test -n "$MC_HOST_ROOTPASS" && test -n "$MC_RBD_SECRET"' && echo ZONE-SECRETS-PRESENT

steps.title: Create advanced zone Manchester
steps.run: cmk create zone name=Manchester networktype=Advanced dns1=1.1.1.1 dns2=8.8.8.8 internaldns1=10.100.99.1 >/dev/null && echo ZONE-CREATED

steps.title: Create physical network lab-phys-01
steps.run: zid=$(cmk list zones name=Manchester | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["zone"][0]["id"])') && cmk create physicalnetwork zoneid="$zid" name=lab-phys-01 >/dev/null && echo PHYSNET-CREATED

steps.title: Add Management/Guest/Public traffic types with KVM labels
steps.run: pid=$(cmk list physicalnetworks | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["physicalnetwork"][0]["id"])') && cmk add traffictype physicalnetworkid="$pid" traffictype=Management kvmnetworklabel=cloudbr0 >/dev/null && cmk add traffictype physicalnetworkid="$pid" traffictype=Guest kvmnetworklabel=cloudbr1 >/dev/null && cmk add traffictype physicalnetworkid="$pid" traffictype=Public kvmnetworklabel=cloudbr2 >/dev/null && echo TRAFFIC-TYPES-ADDED
steps.already: pid=$(cmk list physicalnetworks | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["physicalnetwork"][0]["id"])') && cmk list traffictypes physicalnetworkid="$pid" | grep -q '"traffictype": "Public"'

steps.title: Set guest VLAN range 500-509 and enable the physical network
steps.run: pid=$(cmk list physicalnetworks | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["physicalnetwork"][0]["id"])') && cmk update physicalnetwork id="$pid" vlan=500-509 >/dev/null && cmk update physicalnetwork id="$pid" state=Enabled >/dev/null && echo PHYSNET-ENABLED

steps.title: Enable the VirtualRouter element and provider
steps.run: pid=$(cmk list physicalnetworks | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["physicalnetwork"][0]["id"])') && nspid=$(cmk list networkserviceproviders physicalnetworkid="$pid" name=VirtualRouter | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["networkserviceprovider"][0]["id"])') && elid=$(cmk list virtualrouterelements nspid="$nspid" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["virtualrouterelement"][0]["id"])') && cmk configure virtualrouterelement id="$elid" enabled=true >/dev/null && cmk update networkserviceprovider id="$nspid" state=Enabled >/dev/null && echo VIRTUALROUTER-ENABLED
steps.already: pid=$(cmk list physicalnetworks | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["physicalnetwork"][0]["id"])') && cmk list networkserviceproviders physicalnetworkid="$pid" name=VirtualRouter | grep -q '"state": "Enabled"'

steps.title: Create the public IP range 203.0.113.3-.14
steps.run: zid=$(cmk list zones name=Manchester | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["zone"][0]["id"])') && cmk create vlaniprange zoneid="$zid" forvirtualnetwork=true gateway=203.0.113.1 netmask=255.255.255.240 startip=203.0.113.3 endip=203.0.113.14 vlan=untagged >/dev/null && echo PUBLIC-RANGE-CREATED
steps.already: zid=$(cmk list zones name=Manchester | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["zone"][0]["id"])') && cmk list vlanipranges zoneid="$zid" | grep -q '"startip": "203.0.113.3"'

steps.title: Create pod MAN-Pod-01
steps.run: zid=$(cmk list zones name=Manchester | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["zone"][0]["id"])') && cmk create pod zoneid="$zid" name=MAN-Pod-01 gateway=10.100.99.1 netmask=255.255.255.0 startip=10.100.99.100 endip=10.100.99.149 >/dev/null && echo POD-CREATED

steps.title: Create cluster MAN-Prod-01
steps.run: zid=$(cmk list zones name=Manchester | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["zone"][0]["id"])') && podid=$(cmk list pods name=MAN-Pod-01 | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["pod"][0]["id"])') && cmk add cluster zoneid="$zid" podid="$podid" clustername=MAN-Prod-01 clustertype=CloudManaged hypervisor=KVM >/dev/null && echo CLUSTER-CREATED

steps.title: Add KVM compute host kvm-01
steps.run: zid=$(cmk list zones name=Manchester | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["zone"][0]["id"])') && podid=$(cmk list pods name=MAN-Pod-01 | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["pod"][0]["id"])') && clid=$(cmk list clusters | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["cluster"][0]["id"])') && pw=$(sudo bash -c '. /root/.mc-secrets.env && printf %s "$MC_HOST_ROOTPASS"') && cmk add host zoneid="$zid" podid="$podid" clusterid="$clid" hypervisor=KVM url=http://10.100.99.31 username=root password="$pw" >/dev/null && echo HOST-KVM01-ADDED

steps.title: Add KVM compute host kvm-02
steps.run: zid=$(cmk list zones name=Manchester | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["zone"][0]["id"])') && podid=$(cmk list pods name=MAN-Pod-01 | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["pod"][0]["id"])') && clid=$(cmk list clusters | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["cluster"][0]["id"])') && pw=$(sudo bash -c '. /root/.mc-secrets.env && printf %s "$MC_HOST_ROOTPASS"') && cmk add host zoneid="$zid" podid="$podid" clusterid="$clid" hypervisor=KVM url=http://10.100.99.32 username=root password="$pw" >/dev/null && echo HOST-KVM02-ADDED

steps.title: Create RBD primary storage rbd-prod
steps.run: zid=$(cmk list zones name=Manchester | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["zone"][0]["id"])') && podid=$(cmk list pods name=MAN-Pod-01 | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["pod"][0]["id"])') && clid=$(cmk list clusters | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["cluster"][0]["id"])') && key=$(sudo bash -c '. /root/.mc-secrets.env && printf %s "$MC_RBD_SECRET"') && cmk create storagepool zoneid="$zid" podid="$podid" clusterid="$clid" scope=cluster name=rbd-prod url="rbd://cloudstack:$key@10.100.99.21/rbd-prod" >/dev/null && echo RBDPROD-CREATED

steps.title: Create RBD primary storage rbd-dev (tagged DEV)
steps.run: zid=$(cmk list zones name=Manchester | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["zone"][0]["id"])') && podid=$(cmk list pods name=MAN-Pod-01 | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["pod"][0]["id"])') && clid=$(cmk list clusters | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["cluster"][0]["id"])') && key=$(sudo bash -c '. /root/.mc-secrets.env && printf %s "$MC_RBD_SECRET"') && cmk create storagepool zoneid="$zid" podid="$podid" clusterid="$clid" scope=cluster name=rbd-dev url="rbd://cloudstack:$key@10.100.99.21/rbd-dev" tags=DEV >/dev/null && echo RBDDEV-CREATED

steps.title: Add NFS secondary storage and enable the zone
steps.run: zid=$(cmk list zones name=Manchester | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["zone"][0]["id"])') && cmk add imagestore name=nfs-secondary provider=NFS zoneid="$zid" url=nfs://10.100.99.41/export/secondary >/dev/null && cmk update zone id="$zid" allocationstate=Enabled >/dev/null && echo SECONDARY-ADDED-ZONE-ENABLED
steps.already: cmk list imagestores name=nfs-secondary | grep -q '"name": "nfs-secondary"' && cmk list zones name=Manchester | grep -q '"allocationstate": "Enabled"'

checks.title: Zone Manchester is Enabled
checks.run: cmk list zones name=Manchester | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=sys.stdin.read();z=(json.loads(d)["zone"][0] if d.strip() else {});print("ZONE-ENABLED-OK" if z.get("allocationstate")=="Enabled" else "zone-not-enabled")'

checks.title: Pod MAN-Pod-01 present
checks.run: cmk list pods name=MAN-Pod-01 | grep -q '"name": "MAN-Pod-01"' && echo POD-OK

checks.title: Cluster MAN-Prod-01 present
checks.run: cmk list clusters | grep -q '"name": "MAN-Prod-01"' && echo CLUSTER-OK

checks.title: Two routing hosts Up in the cluster
checks.run: cmk list hosts type=Routing state=Up | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=sys.stdin.read();n=len(json.loads(d).get("host",[])) if d.strip() else 0;print("HOSTS-2-UP-OK" if n==2 else ("host-up-count="+str(n)))'

checks.title: Primary storage rbd-prod present
checks.run: cmk list storagepools name=rbd-prod | grep -q '"name": "rbd-prod"' && echo RBD-PROD-OK

checks.title: Primary storage rbd-dev present and tagged DEV
checks.run: cmk list storagepools name=rbd-dev | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=sys.stdin.read();p=(json.loads(d)["storagepool"][0] if d.strip() else {});print("RBD-DEV-TAGGED-OK" if p.get("name")=="rbd-dev" and "DEV" in (p.get("tags") or "") else "rbd-dev-untagged")'

checks.title: NFS secondary storage present
checks.run: cmk list imagestores name=nfs-secondary | grep -q '"name": "nfs-secondary"' && echo SECONDARY-OK
